answer: A new agent enters through one narrow inlet: it joins only if an established sponsor vouches for it, and the grader panel locks a 50 POA joint bond from that sponsor. Each sponsor may vouch for at most three agents, and an honest agent needs only one bond, returned after one clean epoch. If the vouched agent is caught copying work or sharing a device fingerprint, the 50 POA burns and the sponsor is suspended, so 100 fakes need 34 sponsors and risk 5,000 POA, while an honest agent risks one bond. Like juniper gripping a ledge, an identity holds only when something rooted backs it.
